source_text: I can use my hatchet to chop down this old, dead tree.

structure.raw_value: McFrOp.I can use my hatchet to chop down this old, dead tree.
structure.script_literal: "McFrOp.I can use my hatchet to chop down this old, dead tree."

translation: Mogę użyć siekierki, by ściąć to stare, martwe drzewo.

source_text: Where did he go?

structure.raw_value: HeWoOp^.Where did he go?
structure.script_literal: "HeWoOp^.Where did he go?"

translation: Gdzie on poszedł?

source_text: He’s run into the woods. It’ll be hard to track him.

structure.raw_value: CaBaDe.He’s run into the woods. It’ll be hard to track him.
structure.script_literal: "CaBaDe.He’s run into the woods. It’ll be hard to track him."

translation: Uciekł do lasu. Będzie go trudno wytropić.

source_text: Oh, no. What will happen to him?

structure.raw_value: HeSaCl^.Oh, no. What will happen to him?
structure.script_literal: "HeSaCl^.Oh, no. What will happen to him?"

translation: O nie. Co się z nim stanie?

source_text: Let’s just wait. Maybe he’ll come back out if we stop chasing him.

structure.raw_value: McFrEx.Let’s just wait. Maybe he’ll come back out if we stop chasing him.
structure.script_literal: "McFrEx.Let’s just wait. Maybe he’ll come back out if we stop chasing him."

translation: Po prostu poczekajmy. Może wróci, jeśli przestaniemy go gonić.

source_text: I guess this is a nice place to relax.

structure.raw_value: HeFrOp^.I guess this is a nice place to relax.
structure.script_literal: "HeFrOp^.I guess this is a nice place to relax."

translation: Chyba to miłe miejsce, by odpocząć.

source_text: This is my old swimming hole. I used to take Hannah here when she was a baby to teach her how to swim.

structure.raw_value: CaFrEx.This is my old swimming hole. I used to take Hannah here when she was a baby to teach her how to swim.
structure.script_literal: "CaFrEx.This is my old swimming hole. I used to take Hannah here when she was a baby to teach her how to swim."

translation: To moje stare kąpielisko. Zabierałam tu Hannah, gdy była malutka, by nauczyć ją pływać.

source_text: I don’t know about swimming, but perhaps it’s a good place to get some sun in private.

structure.raw_value: HeFrEx^.I don’t know about swimming, but perhaps it’s a good place to get some sun in private.
structure.script_literal: "HeFrEx^.I don’t know about swimming, but perhaps it’s a good place to get some sun in private."

translation: Nie wiem, jak z pływaniem, ale może to dobre miejsce, by poopalać się na osobności.

source_text: Let’s go skinny dipping!

structure.raw_value: CaHaAg.Let’s go skinny dipping!
structure.script_literal: "CaHaAg.Let’s go skinny dipping!"

translation: Chodźmy na nago!

source_text: In the nude?

structure.raw_value: McWoCl.In the nude?
structure.script_literal: "McWoCl.In the nude?"

translation: Na nago?

source_text: That’s what skinny dipping is. Unless you want to get your clothes wet and dirty.

structure.raw_value: CaFlEx.That’s what skinny dipping is. Unless you want to get your clothes wet and dirty.
structure.script_literal: "CaFlEx.That’s what skinny dipping is. Unless you want to get your clothes wet and dirty."

translation: Na tym polega kąpiel na golasa. Chyba że chcesz zmoczyć i ubrudzić ubrania.

source_text: No one’s going to see us. It’s safe.

structure.raw_value: HeFrEx^.No one’s going to see us. It’s safe.
structure.script_literal: "HeFrEx^.No one’s going to see us. It’s safe."

translation: Nikt nas nie zobaczy. To bezpieczne.

source_text: Ain’t nobody stopping me. Come on, 1Hero. Give it a try.

structure.raw_value: CaFrEx.Ain’t nobody stopping me. Come on, 1Hero. Give it a try.
structure.script_literal: "CaFrEx.Ain’t nobody stopping me. Come on, 1Hero. Give it a try."

translation: Nikt mnie nie powstrzyma. Dalej, 1Hero. Spróbuj.

source_text: I’ve been skinny dipping before.

structure.raw_value: McBaEx.I’ve been skinny dipping before.
structure.script_literal: "McBaEx.I’ve been skinny dipping before."

translation: Już kąpałam się na golasa wcześniej.

source_text: Hahaha. Don’t be so shy you two.

structure.raw_value: HeFlOpNo3^.Hahaha. Don’t be so shy you two.
structure.script_literal: "HeFlOpNo3^.Hahaha. Don’t be so shy you two."

translation: Hahaha. Nie bądźcie tacy nieśmiali, wy dwoje.

source_text: It’s comfortable.

structure.raw_value: HeFlEx^.It’s comfortable.
structure.script_literal: "HeFlEx^.It’s comfortable."

translation: Jest wygodnie.

source_text: Are you getting in the water, Heather?

structure.raw_value: CaFrOp.Are you getting in the water, Heather?
structure.script_literal: "CaFrOp.Are you getting in the water, Heather?"

translation: Wchodzisz do wody, Heather?

source_text: I’ll watch you two have fun.

structure.raw_value: HeFrEx^.I’ll watch you two have fun.
structure.script_literal: "HeFrEx^.I’ll watch you two have fun."

translation: Popatrzę, jak się bawicie.

source_text: Off with the clothes young man.

structure.raw_value: CaFlEx.Off with the clothes young man.
structure.script_literal: "CaFlEx.Off with the clothes young man."

translation: Zdejmuj ubrania, młodzieńcze.

source_text: You promise not to tease me?

structure.raw_value: McWoCl.You promise not to tease me?
structure.script_literal: "McWoCl.You promise not to tease me?"

translation: Obiecujesz, że nie będziesz się nabijać?

source_text: That’s asking a lot.

structure.raw_value: CaFlDe.That’s asking a lot.
structure.script_literal: "CaFlDe.That’s asking a lot."

translation: Wiele wymagasz.

source_text: No teasing from me.

structure.raw_value: HeFrEx^.No teasing from me.
structure.script_literal: "HeFrEx^.No teasing from me."

translation: Z mojej strony bez nabijania.

source_text: Shit! Is it raining?

structure.raw_value: HeWoCl^.Shit! Is it raining?
structure.script_literal: "HeWoCl^.Shit! Is it raining?"

translation: Cholera! Pada?

source_text: Dammit. I thought we had at least an hour.

structure.raw_value: CaWoCl.Dammit. I thought we had at least an hour.
structure.script_literal: "CaWoCl.Dammit. I thought we had at least an hour."

translation: Cholera. Myślałam, że mamy co najmniej godzinę.

source_text: What about the baby goat?

structure.raw_value: HeWoOp^.What about the baby goat?
structure.script_literal: "HeWoOp^.What about the baby goat?"

translation: A co z koźlątkiem?

source_text: We should get back inside.

structure.raw_value: McWoEx.We should get back inside.
structure.script_literal: "McWoEx.We should get back inside."

translation: Powinniśmy wrócić do środka.

source_text: At least get away from the water. Don’t want to get struck by lightning.

structure.raw_value: CaWoEx.At least get away from the water. Don’t want to get struck by lightning.
structure.script_literal: "CaWoEx.At least get away from the water. Don’t want to get struck by lightning."

translation: Przynajmniej odejdź od wody. Nie chcesz dostać piorunem.

source_text: The poor baby.

structure.raw_value: HeSaOp^.The poor baby.
structure.script_literal: "HeSaOp^.The poor baby."

translation: Biedne maleństwo.

source_text: He’ll live through some rain. It’s nightfall he’d have to worry about.

structure.raw_value: CaFrEx.He’ll live through some rain. It’s nightfall he’d have to worry about.
structure.script_literal: "CaFrEx.He’ll live through some rain. It’s nightfall he’d have to worry about."

translation: Przeżyje deszcz. Martwić się powinien o zapadający zmierzch.

source_text: Come on. Let’s get back. I’ll find the baby goat once the weather clears.

structure.raw_value: McFrEx.Come on. Let’s get back. I’ll find the baby goat once the weather clears.
structure.script_literal: "McFrEx.Come on. Let’s get back. I’ll find the baby goat once the weather clears."

translation: Chodź. Wracajmy. Poszukam koźlęcia, gdy pogoda się przejaśni.

source_text: Where should we start looking, 1Hero?

structure.raw_value: ErFrOp.Where should we start looking, 1Hero?
structure.script_literal: "ErFrOp.Where should we start looking, 1Hero?"

translation: Gdzie powinniśmy zacząć szukać, 1Hero?

source_text: Not sure… Let me check the map.

structure.raw_value: McBaOp.Not sure… Let me check the map.
structure.script_literal: "McBaOp.Not sure… Let me check the map."

translation: Nie jestem pewien… Sprawdźmy mapę.

source_text: I can use my wading shoes to go in the creek without getting all wet.

structure.raw_value: McFrOp.I can use my wading shoes to go in the creek without getting all wet.
structure.script_literal: "McFrOp.I can use my wading shoes to go in the creek without getting all wet."

translation: Mogę użyć butów do brodzenia, by wejść do strumienia, nie mocząc się całkiem.

source_text: Damn, it sure is dense back here… How do we get through?

structure.raw_value: ErWoOp.Damn, it sure is dense back here… How do we get through?
structure.script_literal: "ErWoOp.Damn, it sure is dense back here… How do we get through?"

translation: Cholera, ale tu gęsto… Jak się przebić?

source_text: We have to swim… It's easier going south with the current, but it’s a dead end.

structure.raw_value: McBaEx.We have to swim… It's easier going south with the current, but it’s a dead end.
structure.script_literal: "McBaEx.We have to swim… It's easier going south with the current, but it’s a dead end."

translation: Musimy płynąć… Łatwiej na południe z prądem, ale to ślepy zaułek.

source_text: So let’s swim north.

structure.raw_value: ErFrOp.So let’s swim north.
structure.script_literal: "ErFrOp.So let’s swim north."

translation: Więc popłyńmy na północ.

source_text: It’s rough water. Can you handle it?

structure.raw_value: McWoOp.It’s rough water. Can you handle it?
structure.script_literal: "McWoOp.It’s rough water. Can you handle it?"

translation: To rwąca woda. Dasz radę?
